## Checklist
- [ ] `bun run check` is green
- [ ] Player-facing text uses i18n keys, present in **en** and **id** (or `[TODO-ID]` + `needs-translation` label)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (golden snapshot changes explained)
- [ ] No new dependency, or it's added to docs/TECH_STACK.md with a reason
- [ ] Performance budget impact: none / described below
- [ ] Docs updated (GDD numbers, ADR, STATUS/ROADMAP) if needed
- [ ] Assets are original or CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/OFL and listed in `assets/CREDITS.md`
- [ ] Cultural content follows docs/CULTURE_GUIDE.md §7 (if applicable)
- [ ] I agree to license code under MIT and content under CC BY-SA 4.0
